meta.title: CROIX — Light, resolved.
meta.description: Turnkey architectural lighting design, photometric engineering, and control systems. Milanese design leadership, Manila delivery.

hero.intro: Milanese design leadership. Manila engineering. One accountable team for lighting design, DIALux verification, controls, and commissioning — from first sketch to opening night.
hero.imageAlt: A visitor looking at a painting lit by a single warm spotlight

disciplines.intro: Museum-grade hospitality asks for softness, materiality, and restraint. Industrial infrastructure asks for proof, enclosure ratings, and zero failure. We run both from the same drawing set — without cross-contaminating the palette, the typography, or the approval path.
disciplines.footerRight: Same logo. Same standard. Different room.

cards.title: Gallery light
cards.body: Museums, hospitality, and heritage. Soft gradients, honest materials, and a night sky left alone.
cards.imageAlt: Daylight falling through a quiet concrete stair

cards.title: Precision light
cards.body: Explosion-proof, outdoor egress, and marine. Sealed enclosures, verified photometrics, and documents that pass inspection.
cards.imageAlt: Port cranes lit against a deep blue night sky

work.title: Light, in the field.
work.intro: Heritage landmarks, luxury resorts, public transport, and workplaces — often alongside Voltaire Light Design, In-visible lab, and Sergio Boccia Lighting Design.

proof.intro: Lighting is the one trade where “it looks fine” is not a submittal. Every scheme leaves the studio with illuminance values, glare limits, load schedules, and a code path.
proof.imageAlt: DIALux false-colour illuminance map of the Cultural Center of the Philippines grand lobby
proof.imageFooterLeft: Photometric proof, not a mood board
